title: Mobile: add tabs.fields translation key
description:
Add a new "fields" key under the existing "tabs" block in both locale files, for the new bottom-nav Fields tab added in task 2 (`t('tabs.fields')`).

In `mobile_app/src/i18n/locales/he.json:7-12`:
```json
  "tabs": {
    "games": "משחקים",
    "search": "מפה",
    "chats": "צ'אטים",
    "friends": "חברים",
    "fields": "מגרשים"
  },
```
(add a trailing comma after the existing `"friends": "חברים"` line and insert the new `"fields"` line before the closing `},`). Reuses the exact same Hebrew string already used for `field.directory` (line 176 of this same file) for consistency.

In `mobile_app/src/i18n/locales/en.json:2-7` (same block, English): add `"fields": "Fields"` the same way, after the existing `"friends": "Friends"` line (matches `field.directory`'s English value "Fields" at line 176 of this file).

Do not touch any other key in either file.

description:
Closes the remaining feature gaps between the mobile field pages and their web equivalents (`next_app/src/app/fields/[id]/page.tsx`, `next_app/src/components/FieldCard.tsx`): favoriting, the field description text, and a one-tap "create a game at this field" CTA. Depends on task 5 (`FavoriteButton`). The rest of the detail page (schedule, busy chart, map, comments, issue reports, crowd report widget) already exists in `field/[id].tsx` and needs no changes.

In `mobile_app/app/field/[id].tsx`:
1. Add `import FavoriteButton from '@/components/FavoriteButton';` near the other local imports (lines 11-13).
2. Render the button over the header image, matching how web overlays it on the card (`FieldCard.tsx:130-132`): wrap the existing `<Image .../>` at lines 166-168 in a `<View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>` and add `<View style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 12, right: 12 }}><FavoriteButton fieldId={fieldId} /></View>` as a sibling of the `Image` inside that wrapper (only render this when `field.image` is truthy, matching the existing `field.image ? (...) : null` conditional at line 166 — put the `FavoriteButton` inside the truthy branch).
3. Render the field description (present on the `Field` type at `mobile_app/src/services/api/fields.ts:9` but currently never displayed in this screen) right after the sports/type chip row (after line 189's closing `</View>` of the chips `View`, before the price `<Text>` at line 191): `{field.description ? (<Text className="text-gray-600 text-sm mt-3">{field.description}</Text>) : null}`.
4. Add a "create a game here" button, mirroring `next_app/src/components/FieldNewGameButton.tsx` (which opens an inline dialog; mobile already has a dedicated full-screen create flow that accepts a `fieldId` query param — `mobile_app/app/game/new.tsx:42-43` — so navigate there instead of building an inline form). Place it right after the price `<Text>` block (after line 195, still inside the header `<View className="p-4">` from line 169), guarded by `userId` (already destructured from `useAuth()` at line 47) the same way the crowd-report footer is guarded at line 323:
```tsx
{userId && (
    <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={() => router.push(`/game/new?fieldId=${fieldId}`)}
        className="bg-brand rounded-xl py-3 mt-3 items-center"
    >
        <Text className="text-white font-bold">{t('field.createGameHere', 'צור משחק חדש במגרש הזה')}</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
)}
```

In `mobile_app/app/fields/index.tsx` (after task 3's sport-filter changes have landed):
5. Add `import FavoriteButton from '@/components/FavoriteButton';`.
6. In `renderField` (lines 59-86), overlay the button on each row's thumbnail the same way as the detail screen: wrap the `field.image ? (<Image .../>) : (<View .../>)` block (lines 65-71) in a `<View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>` and add `<View style={{ position: 'absolute', top: -4, right: -4 }}><FavoriteButton fieldId={field.id} size={14} /></View>` as a sibling — keep it small (`size={14}`) since the thumbnail itself is only 56x56 (`w-14 h-14`, line 66/68) unlike the full-width header image in the detail screen.

Add the new `field.createGameHere` key used in step 4 to both `mobile_app/src/i18n/locales/he.json` and `en.json` is NOT required since a literal Hebrew default string is passed as the second argument to `t(...)` above (matching this codebase's existing convention of inline fallback strings for newer keys, e.g. `t('field.directory', 'מגרשים')` in `fields/index.tsx:95`) — do not add a formal locale-file entry for it in this task, the inline default is sufficient and consistent with precedent already in this codebase.
